channel.title: Twilio incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Twilio's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Voice Call Failures from a Subset of Twilio Phone Numbers to Switzerland [identified]
item.description: Twilio customers may be experiencing voice call failures from a subset of Twilio Phone Numbers to network subscribers in Switzerland. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 8 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

item.title: Interconnection Infrastructure Upgrade (SG1 – Edge2 Switch) [maintenance]
item.description: Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

item.title: SMS Delivery Receipt Delays from a Subset of Twilio Short Codes to T-Mobile United States [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and SMS delivery receipts from a subset of Twilio Short Codes to T-Mobile network subscribers in the United States are operating normally.

item.title: Multiple delivery failures when sending emails to Microsoft or MS based recipients [resolved]
item.description: Our engineers have monitored the issue and confirmed the issue with email deliveries to Microsoft has recovered to normal levels. All services are now operating normally at this time.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to MobiFone Vietnam [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and SMS delivery from Twilio to MobiFone network subscribers in Vietnam is operating normally.

item.title: MMS Delivery Delays from a Subset of Australia Subscribers to Twilio Australia Phone Numbers [identified]
item.description: Twilio customers may be experiencing MMS delivery delays from a Subset of network subscribers in Australia to Twilio Australia Phone Numbers. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 8 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays and Failures From a Subset of Twilio Long Codes to Vivo and Claro Brazil [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and SMS delivery from a subset of Twilio Long Codes to Vivo and Claro network subscribers in Brazil is operating normally.

item.title: Canada Account Security Service Partner Maintenance [maintenance]
item.description: Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays and Failures from Twilio to Qcell Gambia [identified]
item.description: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays and failures from Twilio to Qcell network subscribers in the Gambia. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 2 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

item.title: United States SMS and MMS Carrier Maintenance - T-Mobile [maintenance]
item.description: Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

item.title: Intermittent Delays and Failures in Message Delivery [resolved]
item.description: Delivery delays and failures have been resolved and message delivery is operating normally at this time.

item.title: Registration Notification Issues [resolved]
item.description: We have fully investigated the registration notification issue triggered by our automated alert, and it was determined that there is no noticeable customer impact. All systems are operational.

item.title: Retroactive Incident: Twilio Personalized Support Phone Line Affected [resolved]
item.description: Intermittent dropped calls were reported on the Twilio personalized support hotline between 2026-08-24 08:10 AM PT and 2026-09-01 10:27 AM PT. The root cause was identified as a bug within Twilio Studio. A patch has been applied, and service has been fully restored.

item.title: Voice Call Failures from a Subset of Twilio Phone Numbers to Multiple Networks in Multiple Countries in Europe [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and voice calls from a subset of Twilio Phone Numbers to network subscribers in affected countries in Europe are operating normally.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Cellcom Israel [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and SMS delivery from Twilio to Cellcom network subscribers in Israel is operating normally.

item.title: Unable to Login to Console [resolved]
item.description: We are no longer experiencing issues when the customers are logging in to the Twilio console. This incident has been resolved.

item.title: MMS Delivery Receipt Delays from a Subset of Twilio Long Codes to GCI United States [identified]
item.description: Twilio customers may be experiencing MMS delivery receipt delays from a subset of Twilio Long Codes to GCI network subscribers in the United States. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. Message delivery may succeed, but delivery receipts may be delayed. We will provide another update in 8 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

item.title: RCS Sender Registration Submission Issues in the United States [resolved]
item.description: We have monitored and resolved the issue with RCS sender registration submission in the United States. All services are now operating normally at this time.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays from a Subset of Twilio Short Codes to Algar Telecom Brazil [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and SMS delivery from a subset of Twilio Short Codes to Algar Telecom network subscribers in Brazil is operating normally.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Multiple Networks in Spain [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and SMS delivery from Twilio to affected networks in Spain is operating normally.

item.title: SMS Delivery Delays from a Subset of Twilio Short Codes to Vivo Brazil [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and SMS delivery from a subset of Twilio Short Codes to Vivo network subscribers in Brazil is operating normally.

item.title: User Authentication Identity SNA Missing Redirects for Three in United Kingdom [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved and User Authentication Identity SNA missing redirects for Three in the United Kingdom is operating normally.

item.title: Live Chat Support Failing for Customers [resolved]

item.description: Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

item.title: Voice E2E Test failures [resolved]
item.description: Voice E2E Test failures has been resolved and is operating normally at this time.

item.title: Increase in 502 HTTP Responses for REST API and Console [resolved]
item.description: 502 Errors when accessing Console or making REST API Calls has been resolved and is operating normally at this time.
